capabilities.name: Book a restaurant table
capabilities.question: Can an AI agent find an open table and book it, or hand you off to finish the booking?

US.note: Google AI Mode finds real-time slots on OpenTable, Resy and Tock for all US users without Labs, and since August 2026 ChatGPT finds bookable tables through OpenTable, Resy and Yelp on all plans.

capabilities.name: Order food, groceries or rides
capabilities.question: Can an AI agent order food, groceries or a ride for you?

US.note: The DoorDash app in ChatGPT builds grocery carts from US retailers for checkout on DoorDash; Instacart and Uber were named ChatGPT app partners, but their current scope was not checked.

evidence.title: DoorDash Launches Grocery Shopping App Within ChatGPT

GB.note: Just Eat's AI assistant in its iOS and Android apps (launched first in the UK in January 2026) takes requests by voice or text, such as "order my usual Friday night curry", and fills the basket for checkout in the app; Just Eat ordering through Alexa+ was announced in March 2026 but no launch was found, no Deliveroo agent was found, and the Uber, Uber Eats and DoorDash apps in ChatGPT are US-only.

evidence.title: Introducing the next evolution of ordering: Just Eat Takeaway.com unveils AI-voice assistant (launching first in the UK)
Just Eat Takeaway.com launches AI Voice Assistant across Europe (after UK and Germany launches; can fill the basket and order your usual)
DID SOMEBODY SAY…. "Alexa, what's for dinner"? (Just Eat ordering on Alexa+ in the UK, launching soon)

DE.note: Lieferando, Just Eat Takeaway.com's German brand, has had an AI assistant in its app since April 2025 that takes orders by text or voice and fills the basket for checkout; Wolt's newsroom shows no AI agent, and the Uber, Uber Eats and DoorDash apps in ChatGPT are US-only.

evidence.title: Lieferando vereinfacht Bestellungen mit KI-Assistent
Just Eat Takeaway.com launches AI Voice Assistant across Europe (after UK and Germany launches; can fill the basket and order your usual)
Wolt press room (no AI ordering agent news)

BR.note: iFood's Ailo agent takes food orders by chat in WhatsApp, open to the general public as a test since October 2025, and hands off a confirmed cart with a link to the iFood app to pay; the only iFood app found in ChatGPT is a merchant tool (Fala Delivery), not consumer ordering, and the Uber Eats ChatGPT app is US-only.

evidence.title: iFood lança agente de IA que permite fazer pedidos pelo WhatsApp

MX.note: No agent ordering was found for Mexico: Uber's help center says the Uber Eats app in ChatGPT shows results only for users in the US, Alexa+ food ordering is US-only, Rappi's WhatsApp assistant (Adri) was announced, mainly for Colombia, with no Mexico launch found, and DiDi Food's DiMi agent (August 2026) only serves restaurants, not shoppers. Searched in October 2026: Rappi, DiDi Food, Uber Eats; kept at low confidence because no company page states the absence.

CL.note: No agent ordering was found for Chile: Uber's help center says the Uber Eats app in ChatGPT shows results only for users in the US, Rappi's WhatsApp assistant (Adri) was announced, mainly for Colombia, with no Chile launch found, PedidosYa's only AI feature found is a 2023 dish recommender in its own app (Santiago only), and no DiDi ordering agent was found. Searched in October 2026: Rappi, PedidosYa, Uber Eats, DiDi; kept at low confidence because no company page states the absence.

CO.note: Rappi announced in 2025 a WhatsApp AI assistant for ordering in natural language and voice-note ordering in Colombia, but no launch was confirmed; the Uber and Uber Eats apps in ChatGPT are US-only.

evidence.title: Rappi anuncia asistente de IA en WhatsApp (Colombia)
Rappi lanzará pedidos por voz con IA en Colombia

IN.note: Swiggy's MCP servers (Food, Instamart, Dineout, since January 2026) let ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini build a cart and place an order once the user adds a custom connector, and Zomato's MCP server (marked for testing) does the same in Claude.
